accepted: No, the degree of the unknown is 2

question.prompt: Is \(x^2-1=0\) a linear equation in one unknown? (Answer “yes” or “no.”)

solutions.explanation: In a linear equation in one unknown, the degree of the unknown must be 1. In this equation, the degree of \(x\) is 2, so it is not.
solutions.title: Check the degree of the unknown
